name: PointObjToCircleCoorForPlot
comment: Returns one closed circle per point, stacked for an XY scatter. Argument order is xCoorArr, yCoorArr, diaArr, numOfPointsPerCircle. diaArr is the diameter, so the radius is dia/2. Point k is at k*360/n degrees, k = 1 to n, counterclockwise from the positive x-axis. The last unique point is on the positive x-axis, then the first point is repeated to close the circle. An #N/A row separates circles. A non-numeric argument returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
